a2a:update-task-status.a2a:status-content: #[output application/json --- {kind: "status-update", taskId: vars.tid, contextId: vars.cid, final: false, status: {state: "working", timestamp: "2026-01-02T03:04:05Z", message: {kind: "message", role: "agent", messageId: "m-w", parts: [{kind: "text", text: "working"}]}}}]

a2a:update-task-artifact.a2a:artifact-content: #[output application/json --- {kind: "artifact-update", taskId: vars.tid, contextId: vars.cid, artifact: {artifactId: "a1", parts: [{kind: "text", text: "chunk " ++ vars.text}]}, lastChunk: true}]

a2a:update-task-status.a2a:status-content: #[output application/json --- {kind: "status-update", taskId: vars.tid, contextId: vars.cid, final: true, status: {state: "completed", timestamp: "2026-01-02T03:04:06Z"}}]

a2a:send-stream-message.a2a:stream-message: #[output application/json --- {message: {kind: "message", role: "user", messageId: "u-1", parts: [{kind: "text", text: vars.text}]}}]

os:store.os:value: #[output application/json --- {"type": typeOf(payload) as String, mime: payload.^mimeType, attrClass: attributes.^class, statusCode: attributes.statusCode, event: (payload as String) replace /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/ with "<uuid>" replace /20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z/ with "<ts>"}]

#[output application/json --- {"type": typeOf(payload) as String, mime: payload.^mimeType, event: (payload as String) replace /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/ with "<uuid>"}]

set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { payloadType: typeOf(payload) as String, mime: payload.^mimeType, attrClass: attributes.^class, attrs: write(attributes - "headers", "application/json"), body: write({events: payload.events filter ($.kind != "task")}, "application/json") replace /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/ with "<uuid>" replace /20[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]+Z/ with "<ts>", routes: (vars.routes pluck ((v, k) -> {key: k as String, value: read(v as String, "application/json")})) orderBy $.key }]
